check.reason: The target is the system: state governors, HHS and the bureaucracy of verification. The joke is that administrators need an extension to build a system that will penalize enrollees for late paperwork, which sides with the patients. It doesn't misstate the story, which is about governors asking HHS for more time. It has no invented numbers or quotes, no mockery of reporters, and none of the excluded topics. The tone is dry and deadpan, and it is actually satirical.

pick.title: Governors ask HHS for more time to implement Medicaid work requirements
pick.headline: Governors Request Extension on Assignment Requiring Others to Submit Paperwork on Time
pick.take: States have asked HHS for more time to implement Medicaid work requirements. Nothing signals confidence in a verification system like the administrators needing a deadline extension to build it. We trust the same flexibility will be offered to everyone who has to navigate it.
